$comment: The closed known-outcome set of property 2 (S0013 decision 8.7). Each fault id lists the outcomes the ported behaviour may produce; anything else a scene observes is a finding under 8.2a. Approved 2026-11-10 by owner quiz (C4-exit: left-by-back is a breach; F2: silent-stale-data allowed; F8-sos: sos-ended-cleanly allowed; F8-watch: stopwatch-resumed and ended-cleanly allowed).

questions.C4-exit: KEYCODE_BACK is not among the water flashlight's exit keys by design (it cannot be told from a wet gesture). If a BACK press leaves the lamp, is that an allowed outcome ('left-by-back') or a breach of 'leave by its exit rule and nothing else'?
questions.F2: With location switched off while the dashboard is open, is silently keeping the last values ('silent-stale-data') acceptable, or must the dashboard say location is off?
questions.F8-sos: SosService is START_NOT_STICKY: a hard kill ends the signal. Is 'sos-ended-cleanly' acceptable for a distress signal, or must it come back ('sos-service-restarted')?
questions.F8-watch: The watch stopwatch is a stored time origin: after a hard kill the measurement is stored and the next open shows it still running ('stopwatch-resumed', added 2026-10-29 by S0022 section 4.3 and S0031, proposed). Is that the only acceptable outcome, or is a dropped measurement with no notification left ('ended-cleanly') also allowed?
